evidence: Reconciled the official Lucerne Leisure Tips 2026 brochure, Lucerne excursions index and Lucerne Day Discoveries page into the discovery landscape.
The final catalogue contains 41 separately identified LX records and retains named discovery lineage without presenting every candidate as an easy Lucerne day trip.
The seven L1-L7 core modules remain the complete canonical modular trip and are not displaced by discovery records.

Verified conservative Pilatus reservation language, Museum Obwalden closure through spring 2027, and explicit weather, last-descent and mobility decision gates.
